source:
@@U00034@@
The LORD.
The HEAVENLY HOST.
The three ARCHANGELS step forward.

@@U00036@@
The sun sings grandly, as of old,
Joining with his brother spheres,
Marching in his destined course,
His thunders clap about their ears.
The angels at his gaze grow strong,
Though fathom it they never may;
These works sublime survive forever
As bright as on the primal day.

@@U00038@@
Swift, ah, swift, past understanding,
The earth whirls ever onward! Mark!
The radiance of that primal day
Alternates with deepest dark.
Behold, the sea’s broad billows surge
From out its depths with primal force,
Lashing rocks and crashing shore,
With sun and stars in endless course.

@@U00040@@
Tempests rage in rivalry
From sea to land, from land to sea,
Forging from their raging furies
A chain of mightiest energy.
Lightning flashes its desolation
With thunderous strokes along the way,
But we, Lord, your angels, honor
The gentle progress of your day.

@@U00042@@
The angels at your gaze grow strong,
Though fathom you they never may;
translation:
@@U00034@@
耶和华啊。
天上的主人。
三位大天使向前迈步。

@@U00036@@
太阳一如既往地歌唱，
与他的兄弟球体一起，
踏着既定的道路前行，
他的雷霆轰鸣在他们耳边。
天使在他的注视下变得坚强，
尽管他们永远无法理解它；
这些崇高的作品永远存在
如同原始之日般明亮。

@@U00038@@
快，啊，快，过去的理解，
地球永远在转动！标记！
那个原始日子的光辉
与最深的黑暗交替。
看哪，大海波涛汹涌
从它的深处带着原始的力量，
猛烈的岩石和破碎的海岸，
太阳和星星在无尽的航程中。

@@U00040@@
竞争中风暴肆虐
从海洋到陆地，从陆地到海洋，
从他们的狂怒中锻造出来
一股最强大的能量链。
闪电闪过它的荒凉
一路上伴随着雷鸣般的打击，
但我们，主啊，你的天使，荣幸
你这一天的缓慢进展。

@@U00042@@
你注视下的天使变得坚强，
尽管他们永远无法理解你；
